shared_context: Three participants need to book a flight from Miami to Stockholm. Options vary by airline, layovers, departure times, and price, all departing within the next two weeks.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project manager who values flexibility in her schedule and prefers evening travel.
personas.private_goal: To find a flight that fits her flexible evening plans without excessive layovers.

A.reason_for: Direct flight with no layovers is convenient.
A.reason_against: Higher price and morning departure don't fit her preference for evening travel.

B.reason_against: Afternoon departure is less ideal than evening.

C.reason_for: Evening departure fits her schedule and price is reasonable.

D.reason_against: Multiple stops add complexity and morning departure is less preferred.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a budget-conscious consultant who prefers efficient travel with reasonable prices.
personas.private_goal: To minimize travel time and cost while keeping layovers manageable.

A.reason_for: No layovers and convenient morning departure.

B.reason_for: Good balance of price and layover duration with afternoon departure.

C.reason_for: Reasonable price and evening departure offers flexibility.

D.reason_against: Two stops increase travel complexity and time.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a frequent flyer who prioritizes direct flights and morning departures for efficiency.
personas.private_goal: To secure the most direct and time-efficient flight despite higher cost.

A.reason_for: Direct flight with no layovers and morning departure maximizes efficiency.

B.reason_against: Longer travel time due to layover.

C.reason_against: Long layover and later departure reduce efficiency.

D.reason_against: Two stops make travel complex and time-consuming.

acceptance_reasons.C: Reasonable price and evening departure offers flexibility.
